designationHistory.name: Matlacha Pass Reservation
designationHistory.indexText: Established Sept. 26, 1908, as the Matlacha Pass Reservation by Executive Order 943, signed by President Theodore Roosevelt, as a preserve and breeding ground for native birds.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Matlacha Pass National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

review.note: Draft described Caloosahatchee NWR (Wilson, July 1, 1920), a separate refuge now managed with Matlacha Pass. Matlacha Pass itself was a T.R. reservation of 1908.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: The refuge was established by President Woodrow Wilson on July 1, 1920 as a ". . . preserve and breeding ground for native birds." Originally, the Caloosahatchee National Wildlife Refuge consisted of several mangrove islands.
